Important Information:

Santa Fe County voters can choose any Early Voting or Election Day polling location to vote.
Click the name of any polling location on this page to view a site overview, including accessibility, parking, entrances, and other details.
Also, The Blue Bus can help you get to the polls!

Same Day Registration (SDR)

Available at all polling locations for voters who need to register or update their registration.
Please bring:

  • Photo ID showing your address, OR
  • Photo ID + a bill or document with your name and address, OR
  • Student ID + current school financial statement

Learn more about Same Day Registration
